summary: Your Defender XDR roles stay exactly as you set them, and the workload job no longer fails after Microsoft's change.

fixes.title: Your Defender XDR roles are never changed
fixes.text: PIM Manager only adds your groups to roles that already exist. It never creates, changes or deletes a role.
fixes.action: Create the role in the Defender portal; Drift: live vs desired lists which ones.

fixes.title: No group gets more than you defined
fixes.text: If a role grants more than you asked for, the group is not added and you see what is extra.

fixes.title: The workload job runs again
fixes.text: Microsoft now shows some role permissions in a shorter form. PIM Manager reads both forms the same way, so the job no longer stops.

fixes.title: Differences in Data sources are only reported
fixes.text: A difference in Data sources is shown to you and no longer fails the run.
